keys.name: ledger.currency
keys.doc: ISO 4217 code of the currency every account of this ledger is denominated in

keys.name: ledger.transfer.blocked-ibans
keys.doc: IBANs that may neither send nor receive, e.g. the sanctions list feed; comma separated

keys.name: ledger.transfer.max-amount
keys.doc: Upper bound for a single transfer; the platform sets it per environment

keys.name: ledger.transfer.require-reference
keys.doc: Reject transfers that carry no reference (causale)

keys.name: quarkus.datasource.jdbc.url
keys.doc: JDBC URL of the application database (Agroal pool)

keys.name: quarkus.datasource.password
keys.doc: Database password, delivered from the vault

keys.name: quarkus.datasource.jdbc.max-size
keys.doc: Upper bound of the connection pool

keys.name: quarkus.http.port
keys.doc: API port, the load balancer target
